about: L3-WP00 characterization suites for lane L3 (shell, onboarding, nav, notifications), planset v060 L3 section 4. Each suite pins one surface as it is at citrate-core a826e441 before an L3 work package changes it; the L3 PR that changes a pinned behavior updates the expectation in a separate commit that says why, and names the suite id here. LQ runs every suite here on every merge-queue group (npm run test:characterization also selects them). Every listed test must be declared in its file and every test in a file must be listed (registry.characterization.test.ts).

suites.pins: launch gate order: a required update renders only the update gate and Root renders nothing beside it; NetworkCompatGate mounts after the body; the Tauri auth gate covers a signed-out session past s0/s1 only; AccessPassGate wraps onboarding only

seven-stage spine s1..s7 and its labels; the S6 model step is hidden until the node pulls the chain with a peer; S6 Continue goes to S7 with a grant, else into the app; Explore sets done and coachDone; Enter starts the coach unless done

store.start(): the node autostarts while nodeIntent is run at any stage; the session resumes inside the custody unlock's finally; an S3 launch asks the chain for the grant; Store.save() never writes the six signed-in identity fields
six places in order; the 33 canonical leaves; all 47 legacy routes resolve, train, people and comms included; an unknown route falls back to hermes/chat

the coach's Groups step claims a running model whatever the model state (false copy pinned on purpose); the coach shows only after onboarding with no ceremony queued; the toast renders its plain text only when set

no notification plugin, permission, tray or Notification API anywhere; the unmounted Comms surface claims an OS notification (pinned on purpose); the comms route opens the Alerts board, whose copy says notifications point there
the run loop calls shutdown_all_sidecars on ExitRequested and Exit and nothing else; each managed sidecar block stops its own supervisor, in today's order; nothing intercepts a close or a quit
this registry lists exactly the L3 surfaces, and each suite file declares exactly the tests listed for it
